name: Novice aux cordes
design: Young adult male, lean and long-limbed, rounded pale mottled cranial dome, six thick short tendrils falling to shoulders, four fleshy facial mandibles plainly spread enough to read. High-collared sleeveless charcoal canvas tunic over a long-sleeved brown undershirt, narrow muted crimson sash, wrapped calves and simple claw-open foot bindings. Holds a compact coil of natural rope at one hip, opposite palm open at chest height; relaxed tilted shoulders. One small soft belt pouch, no armor.

name: Novice des tablettes
design: Young adult female Yautja with fully alien head, short compact practical build, broad amber-brown domed skull with sparse crest studs and short thick tendrils bound low behind the skull. Four external mandibles. Modest black split oversmock over loose dark trousers and dull brick-red woven waist belt. Holds a small plain wooden practice tablet to her torso with both hands and a short bone stylus tucked in belt. Feet planted close, head angled inquisitively toward viewer. Thin wrist cloth wraps, no jewelry or armor.

name: Novice du paquetage
design: Young adult male, unusually tall narrow shoulders and long shins, darker olive speckled skull, flattened wide alien brow and irregular short thick tendrils swept toward one shoulder. Readable four mandibles. Charcoal diagonal wrap jacket with elbow-length sleeves, rust-red broad cloth cross belt, charcoal knee-length divided lower wrap. A rolled blanket secured high across small canvas backpack, hands lightly gripping straps. Modest practical silhouette with one knee bent; no elite metal gear.

name: Novice des gobelets
design: Young adult female, sturdy barrel torso and short lower legs, pale sand scales and ridged domed Yautja head; two bands gather thick scalp tendrils into two low alien bundles, not human pigtail hair. Four mandibles. Simple black short-sleeved tunic, red square apron tied over trousers, brown wraps around forearms and shins. Carries two nested small plain ceramic cups at waist and a folded cleaning cloth in other hand. Slight weight shift, no armor, flat modest chest covering.

name: Novice du cuir
design: Young adult male, medium height with narrow waist and rounded heavy Yautja cranium in dark copper mottling, short thick tendrils clipped into a broad fan. Four external mandibles visible. Coarse charcoal vest fully closed over a grey sleeved tunic, narrow red sash hanging on left and brown loose trousers. Holds an unstitched leather pouch and simple bone awl at chest level, safely pointed away; tool roll soft at belt. Elbows tucked, body turned slightly right.

name: Novice des graines
design: Young adult female alien, tall slender silhouette with long arms, cream-grey speckled domed skull, pronounced asymmetric orbital ridges and midlength thick tendrils tied into a low narrow tail. Four mandibular lobes around inner mouth. Full coverage charcoal long tunic with side vents, brick-red shoulder cloth pinned at one collar, dark calf trousers. Holding a small woven seed basket against left hip and pinching one dried seed pod in right fingers. One soft diagonal satchel, no armor.

name: Novice du repérage
design: Young adult male, wiry hunched attentive stance with bent knees, unusually broad low Yautja dome and olive scales, evenly spaced stubby thick scalp tendrils with no beads. Four external fleshy mandibles clearly readable. Plain black wrap-front short jacket, crimson tied strip on one upper arm, broad charcoal waist wrap over simple trousers. Holds a folded unlettered hide map between hands at waist, small charcoal marking stick behind sash. No advanced scanner, no armor.

name: Novice des bandages
design: Young adult female, average height and broad hips under modest loose clothing, pale stone-grey scales and high domed forehead, thick tendrils of unequal lengths framing fully alien four-mandibled face. Long dark grey cuffed sleeves under charcoal tabard, muted red cloth belt and red-edged brown soft shoulder pouch. Carries two clean rolled bandages cradled in left forearm and a small closed wooden salve box in right palm. Calm grounded wide stance; apprentice simple supplies, no healer advanced kit.

name: Novice de la cour
design: Young adult male, short muscular stocky torso, warm brown patterned alien skull with heavier upper orbital crown, very short thick tendrils clustered back. Visible four facial mandibles. Short charcoal vest with broad lacing over brown cloth undershirt, red waist sash with two uneven tails, black baggy knee trousers, simple wraps exposing clawed toes. One hand resting on a small empty wooden bucket handle held beside thigh, other hand bracing sash. No mask, no armor.

name: Novice du messager
design: Young adult female, extremely slender long-legged build but natural healthy adult proportions, large round amber-grey Yautja head, short asymmetrical thick tendrils, broad orbital ridges and explicit four external mandibles. Modest sleeved black hip-length tunic with rough red shoulder patch, brown close-fitting trousers with loose knee wraps. Small square canvas messenger satchel crossing high on torso; right hand holds its closed flap while left arm hangs freely. Light forward lean with both feet grounded, no elite gear.

name: Novice des pièces
design: Young adult male, tall broad shoulders but skinny arms and legs, green-grey mottled cranium elongated backward, thick tendrils gathered in a short high rear knot. Clearly alien four mandibular lobes. Charcoal sleeveless work smock over long brown sleeves, muted red apron front over loose grey trousers. Holds a shallow wooden tray with a few simple carved bone fasteners, both hands below chest. Soft tool pouch on right hip, simple cloth forearm wraps, no armor.

name: Novice du récit
design: Young adult female alien, petite sloping shoulders and long neck, pale sandy dome with dark lateral mottling, a thick row of short scalp tendrils draped evenly. Four external mandibular appendages. Full coverage simple black calf-length tunic with two side slits over dark trousers, wide brick-red waist wrap. Clutches a slim bound unlettered notebook at sternum and points at its plain closed cover with index claw. Pensive head tilt, heels near each other, no jewelry or armor.

name: Novice des nœuds
design: Young adult male, compact powerful legs and slim shoulders, dark bark brown scales, distinct narrow high domed alien skull, shoulder-length thick scalp tendrils tied at tips with plain cloth. Four facial mandibles. Plain black short tunic over grey long sleeves, diagonal red sash folded wide across waist and coarse knee trousers. Demonstrates a single simple knot in a short rope held between both hands at belly level, one small pouch at back hip. Uneven planted stance, no armor.

name: Novice du foyer
design: Young adult female, tall broad-torsoed sturdy adult, cream speckled head with dark brow grooves, very short heavy tendrils falling just behind ears area with no human ears. Four fleshy external mandibles. Modest charcoal crossed wrap shirt with full sleeves, faded red waist apron over dark brown trousers. Carries a bundled stack of thin kindling entirely in one arm and a small flint wrapped in cloth in the other palm. Simple tied sandals revealing claws, no elite ornament.

name: Novice de la mesure
design: Young adult male, lanky young adult with angled shoulders, pale olive-grey broad cranial dome and flat crown ridge, thick scalp tendrils bundled to one back side. Four external mandibles around separate inner teeth. Charcoal knee-length open-side tabard over a fully closed brown short tunic, narrow crimson woven sash, grey leggings. Examines a simple knotted measuring cord loosely stretched between hands; small leather pencil sleeve on belt. Straight attentive stance, no metallic gadget or armor.

name: Novice des étoffes
design: Young adult female Yautja, short broad frame and sturdy forearms, warm golden speckled domed skull with broad flattened alien brow, a few long thick tendrils contrasting short side tendrils. Four external mandibles visible. Black simple long-sleeved robe ending midcalf, red sash tying a neat fold at hip, plain brown trousers beneath. Holds a folded stack of charcoal fabric against torso and threads a thick blunt bone needle through a loose edge. Modest functional work clothing, no armor.

name: Novice des chemins
design: Young adult male, small wiry adult with notably long hands, dark green mottled alien dome and heavy high eye ridges, short thick tendrils gathered under plain cloth tie at rear. Four clearly distinct mandibular lobes. Charcoal short wrap jacket with unstructured hood resting down, brick-red diagonal belt cloth, dark loose trousers and layered ankle wraps. Carries a small rolled sleeping mat under left arm, other hand giving a calm two-finger acknowledging gesture. No armor.

name: Novice des contenants
design: Young adult female alien, tall slim upright build and medium wide domed skull with silver-grey speckling, shoulder-length thick tendrils in evenly spaced plain bands. Four external mandibles around inner mouth. Coarse charcoal tunic with narrow long sleeves and a rough red rectangular waist panel, brown calf trousers. One hand grips a tiny plain cylindrical corked water flask, other hand supports a closed small wicker container at opposite hip. Claws exposed through plain foot wraps; no advanced kit.

name: Novice des exercices
design: Young adult male, average height with robust shoulders tapering to slim hips, reddish-brown reptilian skin and wide low Yautja dome, thick short tendrils flaring rearward. Four mandibular appendages. Plain black sleeveless tabard over full grey sleeves, wide crimson sash and dark loose knee trousers. Holds one short smooth unadorned wooden practice baton horizontally across thighs, tip down, relaxed novice stance. Only cloth wrist and shin wraps, no lethal weapon, no armor.

name: Novice des provisions
design: Young adult female Yautja, compact rounded torso and thin long arms, pale cream head with dark side scales and tall alien forehead dome, thick scalp tendrils tied into a low short cluster. Four clearly readable facial mandibular lobes. Charcoal tunic with uneven cloth-panel skirt over brown trousers, red sash with a broad folded knot and brown shoulder cloth. Carries a small closed canvas provision sack in both hands at waist, tiny wooden spoon tucked under belt. Quiet patient standing pose, no armor.
